title: Civil War
description: The superhero community is torn apart when the US government introduces the Superhuman Registration Act. Iron Man leads those in favor of regulation, while Captain America champions personal liberties.

title: The Infinity Gauntlet
authors: Jim Starlin; George Pérez; Ron Lim
description: The Mad Titan Thanos has assembled all six Infinity Gems into his gauntlet, giving him absolute power over reality. With a snap of his fingers, half the life in the cosmos is eradicated.

title: Spider-Man: Blue
description: Peter Parker recounts his early years as Spider-Man through voice recordings on Valentine's Day, reflecting on his lost first love, Gwen Stacy, and his budding relationship with Mary Jane Watson.

title: Spider-Man: Kraven's Last Hunt
description: Kraven the Hunter shoots and buries Spider-Man alive, donning his black suit to stalk the streets of New York to prove himself superior to his greatest adversary.

title: Ultimate Spider-Man, Vol. 1: Power and Responsibility
description: A ground-up reinvention of Peter Parker for the 21st century. High school outcast Peter is bitten by a genetically engineered spider, learning life lessons about power and responsibility.

title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
description: In a dystopian 2013 where mutant-hunting Sentinels have conquered America and imprisoned mutants in internment camps, Kate Pryde projects her consciousness back in time to prevent a pivotal assassination.

title: X-Men: The Dark Phoenix Saga
description: Jean Grey is corrupted by cosmic psionic power, transforming into the malevolent Dark Phoenix and devouring a star, forcing the X-Men to fight the Shi'ar Imperial Guard to save her soul.

title: Wolverine: Old Man Logan
description: Fifty years after the world's supervillains united to eliminate every hero, an aging, pacifist Logan embarks on a cross-country delivery mission alongside blind Hawkeye to protect his family.

title: Deadpool Kills the Marvel Universe
description: What if Deadpool lost what little sanity he had left? The Merc with a Mouth turns his swords, guns, and psychotic wit against every hero and villain in the Marvel Universe.

title: Daredevil: Born Again
description: Karen Page sells Matt Murdock's secret identity for drugs. The information falls into the hands of Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin, who systematically dismantles Daredevil's career, home, and sanity.

title: Planet Hulk
authors: Greg Pak; Carlo Pagulayan; Aaron Lopresti
description: Exiled into deep space by the Illuminati, the Hulk crash-lands on the savage alien gladiatorial planet Sakaar, rising from enslaved gladiator to the planet's revolutionary Green King.

title: Thor: God of Thunder, Vol. 1: The God Butcher
description: Across three disparate timelines, Thor of the Viking past, the Avenger present, and the ruined future battles Gorr the God Butcher, a relentless zealot murdering deities across the universe.

title: Doctor Strange: The Oath
description: Doctor Strange investigates a gunshot attempt on his own life while embarking on a desperate race across supernatural and pharmaceutical realms to find an elixir to cure Wong's terminal cancer.

title: Hawkeye, Vol. 1: My Life as a Weapon
description: What does Clint Barton do when he's not an Avenger? Armed with bows, arrows, and an attitude, Clint teams up with Kate Bishop and Lucky the Pizza Dog against track-suited Russian mobsters.

title: Black Panther: A Nation Under Our Feet, Book 1
description: National Book Award winner Ta-Nehisi Coates crafts a dramatic tale of political upheaval in Wakanda as King T'Challa grapples with domestic uprising and superhuman terrorist group The People.

title: Batman: Year One
description: A gritty origin depicting Bruce Wayne's initial, flawed attempts fighting crime in corrupt Gotham alongside newly transferred Lieutenant James Gordon.

title: Batman: The Dark Knight Returns
description: A fifty-five-year-old Bruce Wayne comes out of retirement in a decaying, crime-ridden Gotham, battling the Mutants, Two-Face, the Joker, and ultimately Superman.

title: Batman: The Killing Joke
description: The Joker escapes Arkham Asylum and attempts to drive Commissioner Gordon insane by proving that one bad day can reduce anyone to madness.

title: Batman: The Long Halloween
description: Batman, James Gordon, and DA Harvey Dent forge an alliance against Carmine Falcone's mob, while a serial killer dubbed 'Holiday' murders mobsters on major holidays.

title: Watchmen
description: Set in an alternate 1985 Cold War America where masked vigilantes are outlawed, the murder of The Comedian brings Rorschach to investigate a conspiracy threatening world survival.

title: V for Vendetta
description: In a post-apocalyptic fascist Britain, a theatrical anarchist wearing a Guy Fawkes mask wages a campaign of retribution and liberation, inspiring young Evey Hammond.

title: All-Star Superman
description: After cellular poisoning from the sun leaves him with only one year to live, Superman sets out to fulfill his final twelve labors, leaving a lasting testament of compassion and hope.

title: Flashpoint
description: Barry Allen wakes up in an altered timeline where he has no powers, his mother is alive, Thomas Wayne is Batman, and Aquaman and Wonder Woman are tearing Europe apart in a devastating war.

title: Invincible, Vol. 1: Family Matters
description: Mark Grayson is a normal high schooler whose dad is Omni-Man, the most powerful superhero on Earth. When Mark inherits powers of his own, he begins learning the harsh realities of being a hero.

title: The Boys, Vol. 1: The Name of the Game
description: In a world where corporate superheroes abuse their fame and indulge in depravity, Billy Butcher recruits Wee Hughie into 'The Boys'—a CIA-backed black ops crew keeping 'supes' in line.
